if: the supply is a supply of services
tax is NOT paid or liable to be paid on reverse charge basis
then: the time of supply is the EARLIEST of the dates in s.13(2)(a), (b) and (c) — see GST-TIME-SERVICES-002, -003 and -004
note: s.13(2) says EARLIEST of the following dates, where s.12(2) for goods says EARLIER. The wording differs and so does the clause count — do not carry the goods rule across.

evidence.quote: The liability to pay tax on services shall arise at the time of supply, as determined in accordance with the provisions of this                       section.
